title: Phase 6 D-06 push-down superset probe result
description: A SIBLING of spike-result.schema.json and of o07-body-length.schema.json, never a reuse of either. Phase 0's schema is shaped around a `spike` id, a `thresholds_set` enum closed over Phase 0's own threshold names, and a `measurements` ARRAY of name/value/unit triples; O-07's is shaped around four named encodings and one verdict per read path. This artifact is a TRANSCRIPT: one row per captured fixture carrying Caido's own boolean, plus the exact clause those booleans were produced against. Folding it into either sibling would have meant widening a closed enum measured on another build — the one edit Pitfall 7 and D-21 both exist to prevent.

probe.description: The Phase 6 DECISION this artifact discharges. D-06 is the only one that writes into this schema today; the pattern admits a sibling rather than hard-coding one literal.

status.description: `not_run` is a FIRST-CLASS terminal state, not a failure dressed up. D-23: a leg that could not run is recorded with its reason and never as a pass. `pass` here means only that the capture completed and the transcript is whole — the SUPERSET RELATION is decided by tests/phase6-pushdown.spec.ts against the shipped classifier, never by this file.

reason.description: REQUIRED when status is `not_run`. What made the capture unreachable, in words a later reader can act on.

binary.description: The build this transcript describes. T-06-09: an artifact that does not name the binary it was produced by cannot be checked against the two-caido-cli hazard at all.

clause.description: The EXACT bytes evaluated, and how they were obtained. tests/phase6-pushdown.spec.ts asserts `value` byte-identical to the shipped SCAN_KIND_CLAUSE — which is the only thing tying answers produced in a runtime this repo's test process cannot reach to the constant that ships. The route is an engineering convenience; that assertion is the guarantee.

route.description: `node-type-stripping` reads the exported constant by importing the TypeScript source directly on a Node that strips types. `built-backend-bundle` falls back to reading it out of the build output when that is unavailable.

echoed_by_probe.description: What the probe handed BACK. Recorded separately from `value` so that a probe that silently normalised the clause is visible rather than assumed away.

fixtures.description: One entry per manifest fixture that reached the traffic table. EMPTY when status is `not_run` — a recorded verdict on a run that did not happen is the shape D-23 forbids.

fail_closed.description: 06-04's fail-CLOSED property, EXECUTED against a real Caido parser rather than cited from the SDK's JSDoc (.planning/WINDOWS.md entry 72). TWO legs, because one proves nothing: the balanced control must not throw, and the comment-truncated composition — DefMiner's clause followed by an operator clause ending in `//`, which is exactly what composeScanFilter would emit if its re-validation were bypassed — must. Whether the pair constitutes fail-closed is asserted in tests/phase6-pushdown.spec.ts, never here.

unmatched.description: The two directions the join can fail. A fixture that never reached the traffic table must be VISIBLE here rather than silently dropping out of the proof, and a stored pair the manifest does not name must not be quietly folded in.
